_source: NOCLIP design doc pp. 26-28 (entities) and pp. 22-23 (the deep levels' entities). behaviour is the engine's behaviour class; damage per hit; speed m/s (walk / chase); bounty is the first photo's pay (credit).

entities.name: Smiler
entities.tell: A grin in the dark; your headlamp flickers within 10 m
entities.counter: Point your light away, back off slowly, never run; a flare scares it 30 s; it can't enter a lit room

entities.name: Hound
entities.tell: Panting and scrabbling; a howl before the pack moves
entities.counter: Walk, don't run; stand still and hold eye contact (it hesitates); bandage bleeds; a slammed door holds it 10 s

entities.name: Faceling
entities.tell: Silent; they stop when you look at them
entities.counter: Don't touch; trade if they offer

entities.name: Duller
entities.tell: A low drone like the hum
entities.counter: Keep moving; light makes them freeze

entities.name: Wretch
entities.counter: Keep sanity up (almond water); a group with high sanity is invisible to them

entities.name: Clump
entities.counter: Look up; stay away from pipe-heavy junctions; fire (a flare)

entities.name: Skin-Stealer
entities.tell: Its 'teammate' speaks a beat late; it walks too smoothly; it never picks up loot
entities.counter: Ask what only the real one knows; offer almond water; stay together; the scanner shows no heartbeat

entities.name: Partygoer
entities.tell: Party music; a balloon drifting past
entities.counter: Never accept; pop their balloons

entities.name: Deathmoth
entities.counter: Turn off lights; fire; don't touch eggs

entities.name: The Neighbors
entities.tell: A silhouette in a lit window
entities.counter: Keep a teammate watching while you work

entities.name: Cave Spider
entities.counter: Burn webs; walk on rock not dust; they hate crystal light

entities.name: The Leviathan of 7
entities.tell: The water goes still; a low groan
entities.counter: Keep swims under 60 s; a rope from the house

entities.name: Scarecrow
entities.counter: Keep it in sight; climb high; burn it (a flare)

entities.name: Seer
entities.counter: Break line of sight; cover them

entities.name: Mirror Thing
entities.counter: Don't stare at mirrors; hit it once

entities.name: Orderly
entities.counter: Heal above half; hide in a ward with the door shut

entities.name: Sentry
entities.counter: Hack a terminal to stop it; an EMP

entities.name: Patient
entities.counter: Watch it; move as a group

entities.name: The Warden
entities.counter: Be in a cell when the bell rings; pick the lock (crowbar, loud)

entities.name: The Crew
entities.counter: As Skin-Stealers

entities.name: The Friends
entities.counter: Don't put loot down; play with them and they give it back

entities.name: The Innkeeper
entities.counter: Pay for drinks (yes, really)
